summary: Frontend-only verification of the NEW 'Onboard Estate' importer wizard in CRM Corporate → Aftersales Contracts, plus a smoke regression of every Aftersales sub-tab. Wizard drove the real 707-row Wiltshire workbook end-to-end (upload → analyse → map → build → review edits → commit) and matched the backend's curl-verified numbers exactly. All 11 Aftersales sub-tabs render, the AlphaCo demo contract (PF-MA-CMPDEMO) still appears in Contracts & Renewals compliance, Reports shows ARR/forecast, and AI Assistant still generates a contract summary.

issues: Dev-only hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping dynamic option text in a <span>. Not a runtime bug, but the warning noise is worth flagging.

action_items: CLEAN UP QA DATA: The wizard committed a real estate under customer name 'ZZ QA Onboard Co'. It created 17 sites, 707 equipment records, and 17 DRAFT contracts numbered PF-MA-IMP-2609-01 through PF-MA-IMP-2609-17 (all in Iso Demo Fitness org). Purge before demo/prod cutover.
(Optional) suppress or work around the <span>-in-<option> hydration warning from the visual-editor instrumentation.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js SUB_TABS includes 'contracts' but TabComp map excludes it — it is handled via a special-case ternary in the shell (line 2037). Works, but easy to break; consider putting the ContractsTab component in the map or making the ternary explicit with a comment.

EstateOnboarding.js is self-contained and clean (377 lines). Good use of data-testid throughout. Only nit: the 'exceptionsOnly' default is true — first-time users may not realise there are more rows until they untoggle.
